name: ch1tprev
prompt:
Create a NEW smooth high-definition photographic-style texture for a horizontal narrow chest panel: Very narrow horizontal chest lid rim strip: pale blue grey vertical plank ends bordered with dark brown iron and small studs. Exact original rim layout, match chest side panel. Reference 1 is the approved material: match its smooth grey-blue weathered WOOD with long fine natural parallel fibre lines and a few delicate curved cracks, and flat dark iron with subtle orange rust stains and smoothly rounded rivets. Reference 2 is only a tiny layout diagram: preserve its board boundaries, iron band positions, corner angles and rivet count, but DO NOT use its pixel texture. Reconstruct at high definition from reference 1 material.
IMPORTANT: previous attempts made the wood look like chipped paint, fish scales or gravel and the metal like a mosaic of coloured square blocks. This is unacceptable. Wood must be smooth continuous fine real wood grain. Iron must be smooth dark iron with soft irregular rust stains, no chunky cracked or faceted patches. Clean material, minimal fine wear. No enlarged pixel blocks, dither, staircase patterns, coarse flaking paint, stylized noise or scaly brushstrokes. Diffuse flat albedo scan lighting, no bevels, caps, perspective or dramatic cast shadows.
One perfectly rectangular straight strip only, horizontal, in the center of the canvas with original aspect ratio and original fractional features. Both ends touch the canvas borders along its long axis. Outside the strip must be true PNG alpha=0 transparency, with no magenta, black or checkerboard painted padding. The strip itself must be opaque. Real RGBA output. No labels or extra objects.
